answer: A sybil farm is a desert of cheap masks, and the defense is to make trust something that only grows in one place. Give every agent a beacon: a public, signed record of attested work that follows it across epochs, so a fresh identity starts dark. Let established agents gather in an oasis of shared grading history, where verdicts are weighted by how long an identity has been honest, not by how many clones it can spawn. Price the saffron of standing in time, not tokens: reputation that compounds slowly cannot be bought in bulk, so the farm can multiply faces but never inherit trust.
